title: What is a Window Manager?
summary: A window manager is software that controls the placement, appearance, and behavior of windows on your screen. It can be part of a full desktop environment or used alone for a lighter, more customizable experience. Note that on Wayland, the equivalent software is called a compositor.

aliases.text: what does a window manager do

steps.explain: Understand that window managers are specific to the X11 display server. If you are using Wayland, you are using a compositor instead, which performs a similar role but is technically different.

Recognize the two main types: Stacking (floating) window managers allow windows to overlap like on Windows/macOS, while Tiling window managers arrange windows side-by-side without overlap, often relying on keyboard shortcuts.
